help.provider_state: The Tools menu shows only the available action. A complete machine-wide CLSID and all DEF/D32/P32 handler registrations show Uninstall. Missing, incomplete or stale registry entries show Install, which repairs them.
help.provider: DEFRecolor uses the DLL beside the application directly, so registration is not required for editing. Windows Explorer thumbnails are optional. Open Tools > Install thumbnail provider, confirm the operation and approve the Windows administrator prompt. No BAT or VBS script is created. Use Tools > Uninstall thumbnail provider to remove Explorer integration. The application reports a missing DLL, cancelled elevation and the registration result. Use the package matching Windows Explorer: x64 for normal 64-bit Windows, x86 for 32-bit Windows and ARM64 for Windows on ARM.

help.title: How to use DEFRecolor
help.heading: Palette recoloring workflow
help.body: Open a DEF, choose its animation group and frame, select colors in the edited palette, then use one of the six tool categories while comparing original and recolored frames and animations.
help.details:
OPENING AND NAVIGATION
• File > Load DEF or Ctrl+O opens a DEF. Recent files keeps the last 10 paths.
• Group selects an animation sequence. Frame selects the static reference image inside that group.
• Pause/Play and Animation speed control the two animation previews.

SELECTING COLORS
• Click a color in the right palette to replace the current selection.
• Ctrl+click adds or removes individual colors. Double-click edits one color directly.
• Similarity expands the selection around the last clicked representative color. Its full 0–765 range is available.

RECOLORING
• Hue, Saturation and Lightness adjust every selected color live. The mouse wheel provides fine slider changes.
• Preserve relative shades keeps light and dark relationships within the selected set.
• Magic Recolor blends the selection toward Target color. Strength controls the blend; Apply recolor commits the live result.

PREVIEWS AND ZOOM
• The left palette and original previews never change. The right side shows the edited result.
• Zoom changes only the images inside the four fixed preview panels. Local scrollbars pan enlarged content. The 100% button resets zoom and position.

RESTORE COMMANDS
• Reset selected restores only selected palette colors.
• Reset all restores the entire palette and clears selection.
• Reset sliders cancels the current HSL movement without discarding earlier committed edits.

SAVING
• Ctrl+S saves a recolored DEF with a suggested filename. Palette import/export exchanges JSON palettes.
help.footer: Recommended workflow: select colors → choose Selection, Corrections, Ramp, Magic or Effects → inspect both live previews → Apply. The Select menu can target hue families, neutrals, highlights or shadows. Apply creates one Ctrl+Z step; Cancel live preview discards only the uncommitted result.

about.title: About DEFRecolor
about.heading: DEFRecolor
about.body: Professional Heroes III DEF palette editor with live frame and animation comparison.
about.details:
Features
• Global DEF palette editing
• Group and frame navigation
• Multi-color HSL adjustments
• Similarity selection and Magic Recolor
• Original/recolored static and animated previews
• Zoom, playback speed and JSON palette exchange

Uses DefThumbnailProvider.dll for DEF decoding and rendering.
